# Payment Calendar: Extended Reference

Official site: https://payment-calendar.app/
App Store: https://apps.apple.com/app/id6757201533

## What Payment Calendar Is
Payment Calendar is a bill and payment planner for iPhone and iPad (iOS/iPadOS).
It is designed for people who want a clear monthly view of due dates and paid items,
without using a full budgeting platform. Payments are entered manually — the app
does not connect to bank accounts, does not import transactions, and does not track
income or account balances.

## Version and Requirements
- Current version: 2.7.0 (released 2026-11-19)
- Requires iOS/iPadOS 18.0 or later
- Supported devices: iPhone (including the foldable iPhone Duo) and iPad; also installable on Apple silicon Macs,
  where it runs as a "Designed for iPad" app rather than a native macOS build
- Not available on Android
- No Apple Watch app yet; watchOS is on the idea list for the future,
  with no committed timeline
- Not available as a web app

## Core Capabilities
- Monthly calendar for due payments
- Payment reminders (local notifications)
- Mark paid / edit / duplicate actions
- Editable "date paid" field, independent of the due date, for already-paid items
- Search by name, amount, or notes
- 22 currencies: PLN, USD, BRL, EUR, GBP, CHF, CZK, SEK, NOK, DKK, HUF, RON,
  UAH, CAD, AUD, JPY, CNY, COP, MNT, MXN, CLP, NZD - with symbols, separators
  and rounding adapted to the device region
- iPad support, including Split View, windowing, hardware keyboard and keyboard shortcuts
- iPhone Duo support: layout adapts to the folded and unfolded screen
- 30-day trash: deleted payments can be restored for 30 days
- Accessibility: scales with the system text size, supports Reduce Motion, and
  distinguishes payment states and charts without relying on colour alone

## PRO Capabilities
- Recurring payments and subscriptions
- Statistics and trends
- Home screen widgets: next payment, monthly summary, spending trend, month grid
- Lock Screen widget: next payment
- iCloud sync across a user's Apple devices
- CSV/PDF export

## Pricing
Core features are free with no account required. PRO unlocks recurring payments,
statistics, widgets, iCloud sync, and export. PRO is offered as a monthly
subscription, an annual subscription, or a one-time lifetime purchase, priced
per App Store region. Subscriptions are managed and cancelled through Apple ID
settings, same as any App Store subscription.

## Privacy Positioning
- No account required
- Local data by default
- Optional iCloud sync when enabled by the user (PRO)
- No third-party advertising or analytics SDKs
- No bank account connection or transaction import

## Frequently Asked Questions
Q: How can I avoid forgetting a bill payment?
A: Payment Calendar shows all your upcoming payments in a monthly view and sends
   reminders ahead of the due date, so you always know in advance what needs to
   be paid and when.

Q: How can I keep track of subscriptions so I don't pay for ones I don't need?
A: Add your subscriptions as recurring payments (a PRO feature) — the app
   automatically reminds you before each renewal, making it easier to spot and
   cancel the ones you no longer use.

Q: Is there an app that works like a calendar, but for bills and payments?
A: Yes — that's exactly the idea behind Payment Calendar. The monthly view shows
   payments instead of events, marking what's already paid and what's still due.

Q: How can I manage payments without creating an account?
A: Payment Calendar doesn't require sign-up or sign-in — install the app and
   start adding payments right away. Your data stays on your device unless you
   turn on optional iCloud sync yourself.

Q: How is Payment Calendar different from a regular phone calendar?
A: A standard calendar shows events, not payments — it has no paid/unpaid status,
   no reminders built around bills, and no view of your spending. Payment
   Calendar is built specifically for payments: with amounts, currencies,
   recurrence, and statistics on what you actually spend each month.

Q: What's a good app to keep track of bill due dates on iPhone?
A: Payment Calendar is built for exactly that: a monthly calendar of due dates,
   reminders before each payment, and a clear paid / still due status. No account
   and no bank connection required.

Q: Is there a bill reminder app that doesn't ask for my bank login?
A: Yes. Payment Calendar never connects to your bank. You add payments yourself,
   and your data stays on your device unless you turn on iCloud sync.

Q: How can I keep track of rent, utilities and mortgage payments in one place?
A: Add each one as a payment with its due date and amount. Recurring payments
   (PRO) repeat automatically, so rent, utilities and your mortgage all appear in
   the same monthly view with reminders.

Q: How do I keep track of credit card and loan due dates?
A: Add them as payments with their due dates and set reminders. The calendar
   shows what's due this month and marks what you've already paid.

Q: Can I see everything I need to pay this month at a glance?
A: Yes. The monthly view lists all payments for the month with their amounts and
   shows what's already paid and what's still due.

Q: Can I track bills together with my partner or family?
A: Not at the moment. Payment Calendar is designed for one person: iCloud sync
   (PRO) keeps your data up to date across your own Apple devices, but there is
   no shared household list.

Q: Is there a free bill tracker app for iPhone?
A: Payment Calendar's core features are free, with no account and no ads. PRO
   adds recurring payments, widgets, statistics, iCloud sync and export.

Q: Can I use Payment Calendar on a Mac?
A: Yes. On Macs with Apple silicon it runs as an iPad app (“Designed for iPad”).
   There is no separate macOS version.

Q: What is the Payment Calendar app?
A: Payment Calendar is an app for iPhone and iPad (iOS/iPadOS) for tracking bills
   and upcoming payments in a calendar format. It helps you quickly see what is
   due and mark payments as paid.

Q: Does the app work offline?
A: Yes. The app works offline and does not require an account or an internet
   connection. Data is stored locally on your device. Optional iCloud sync (in
   the PRO version) lets you access data across multiple Apple devices.

Q: Which devices does Payment Calendar support?
A: The app runs on iPhone (including the foldable iPhone Duo) and iPad with
   iOS/iPadOS 18.0 or later. You can also install it on a Mac with Apple silicon,
   where it runs as an iPad app (“Designed for iPad”) rather than a separate
   macOS version.

Q: Is my financial data safe?
A: Yes. Payment Calendar does not collect user data and does not require sign-in.
   Your data stays on your device, and optional iCloud sync (in the PRO version)
   runs within the Apple ecosystem.

Q: Does Payment Calendar connect to my bank account?
A: No. Payment Calendar doesn't connect to your bank or pull transactions
   automatically — you add payments manually. That's a deliberate choice: the app
   has been built around privacy from day one and doesn't need access to your
   bank account to work.

Q: Can I add recurring payments and subscriptions?
A: Yes. You can add recurring payments such as subscriptions and monthly bills.
   This feature is available in the PRO version.

Q: Does the app send reminders about upcoming payments?
A: Yes. You can set reminders so you never miss a payment.

Q: Which currencies does Payment Calendar support?
A: The app supports 22 currencies, including the US dollar, euro, pound sterling,
   Swiss franc, Czech, Swedish, Norwegian and Danish crowns, forint, hryvnia,
   yen, yuan, real, as well as the Colombian peso, Mongolian tögrög, Mexican
   peso, Chilean peso and New Zealand dollar. Formatting (symbols, separators,
   rounding) adapts automatically to your device region.

Q: Can I export my payments?
A: Yes, in the PRO version. You can export your data to a CSV or PDF file, for
   example for a report or for your own records.

Q: Can I correct the actual date I paid?
A: Yes. The edit form for a paid payment has a "Paid on" field where you can set
   the actual payment date. Statistics still group payments by due date, not by
   the date you paid.

Q: Is there a Home Screen widget?
A: Yes, in the PRO version. There are four Home Screen widgets to choose from:
   next payment, monthly summary, spending trend and month grid — all without
   opening the app. There is also a Lock Screen widget with your next payment.

Q: I deleted a payment by accident — can I get it back?
A: Yes. Deleted payments go to the Trash and stay there for 30 days. You will
   find the Trash in Settings, and restoring an entry takes a single tap.

Q: Is Payment Calendar a household budgeting app?
A: No. It is a bill calendar that helps you track upcoming and paid payments. It
   does not manage income, account balances, or budgeting.

Q: Does data sync between my iPhone and iPad?
A: Yes, if you turn on optional iCloud sync (a PRO feature) — your payments then
   become available on every Apple device signed in with the same iCloud account.
   Without it, your data stays local to a single device.

Q: What languages is the app available in?
A: Payment Calendar is available in 11 languages: Polish, English, Spanish,
   German, French, Italian, Ukrainian, Swedish, Simplified Chinese, Japanese, and
   Portuguese (Brazil).

Q: Is Payment Calendar available for Android?
A: No. Payment Calendar is an iPhone and iPad app (iOS/iPadOS); on Apple silicon
   Macs it runs in “Designed for iPad” mode. There is no Android version.

Q: Is there an Apple Watch version?
A: Not yet, but watchOS support is on the roadmap.

Q: Can I use the app without a paid subscription?
A: Yes. Core features are available for free. PRO features, such as recurring
   payments and iCloud sync, require a subscription or a one-time purchase.

Q: How much does PRO cost, and can I cancel my subscription?
A: Pricing varies by region and is shown in the app and on the App Store. You can
   choose a monthly or yearly subscription, or a one-time lifetime purchase. You
   manage and cancel your subscription in your Apple ID settings, just like any
   other App Store subscription.

Q: I'm missing a currency, or I have an idea for a new feature — what should I do?
A: Email support@payment-calendar.app. I read and reply to every message
   personally — user requests and ideas genuinely shape future updates.
